advisory.finding: The 'sidecar-not-emitted' readable=False branch (rec.get('sidecar_emitted') is False) is untested. This branch implements the documented READONLY contract (no sidecar / terminal BLOCK has no signed attestation), yet no test drives a plan_review record with sidecar_emitted=False.
merged_from: The 'review-result-generation-unknown' branch (reviewed_at is None) and the entire _job_started_at_ns helper are untested. When a terminal plan_review record has sidecar_emitted True but no sidecar_reviewed_at, the code falls through to compute job_started_at and set reason='review-result-generation-unknown'; no test exercises this or any of _job_started_at_ns's three resolution strategies (started_at_ns, started_at, job_id prefix).

The non-terminal 'run-{status}' findings branch is untested. When gate_status is polled while the plan_review run is still 'running', _review_result_status returns readable=False with reason 'run-running', but no test polls findings before the run settles.
advisory.suggested_fix: Record a plan_review run with status='passed', sidecar_emitted=False and assert gate_run_status(...)['findings'] == readable False, reason 'sidecar-not-emitted'.

blocking.finding: bugfix-size-attestation: this change touches 195 non-test line(s) — over the 150-line floor for a bug fix — but bug 01c4-cca2-ec11-4530 has no acceptable plan-review attestation (verdict: unsigned; no plan-review attestation record). A fix like this is a design change wearing a bug label: write the fix plan into the ticket's description, run `rebar review-plan 01c4-cca2-ec11-4530` (it auto-escalates a bug with non-test file impact to the full review and SIGNS an attestation on a PASS; if the review passed but no attestation landed, `rebar sign-review 01c4-cca2-ec11-4530` re-persists it cheaply, and `rebar review-plan 01c4-cca2-ec11-4530 --status` confirms it is current without an LLM call), then re-push.
